meta.title: Huynh Quoc Tuan
meta.description: Frontend developer with 2+ years of React.js and Next.js, shipping Expo/React Native apps and .NET backends, at home in monorepos, CI and design systems.

hero.name: Huynh Quoc Tuan
hero.positioning: Frontend-led full-stack engineer — web, mobile, and backend when the project needs it.
hero.current: Currently building EMR/HIS products at MedViet — web and mobile for hospitals.

about.title: About
about.experience: Frontend Developer with 2+ years of experience building and maintaining scalable web applications using React.js and Next.js. Frontend is home ground, and when a project has needed it I have shipped Expo/React Native apps as well as .NET 8, Spring Boot and PayloadCMS backends. Used to working in a monorepo with shared CI and a shared design system, turning Figma designs into clean, responsive interfaces, and comfortable with SSR, ISR and state management to improve performance and user experience.
about.mindset: Good teamwork and communication. Fast learner with a strong adaptation mindset. Interested in performance optimization, source structure, and user experience. Able to work across frontend and backend when the project requires it.

bullets.monorepo: Bootstrapped the shared frontend monorepo (Bun + Turborepo, React 19 + Vite, Vitest and Playwright in CI) and built the health-examination module on it: patient sign-in through IAM with captcha, exam sheets generated from a form server, and per-group saving and e-signature.
bullets.mobile: Built the EMR mobile app with Expo/React Native (NativeWind, TanStack Query, Zustand): in-department patient list, medical records, lab results, QR scanning, sign-off dossiers and e-signature; restructured the app into a monorepo with an SDK service layer, and cleared an ANR by flattening date-grouped lists into a row stream.
bullets.legacy: Maintained the legacy EMR web app (Next.js 14 + Redux): prescription and service-package screens, the labor chart, permissions and web configuration.
bullets.dotnet: Implemented .NET 8 command and query handlers (EF Core, MediatR) on the HIS server for the medical service catalogue and prescription templates.

vda2025.label: VDA 2025
vda2025.tooltip: Excellent Digital Technology Product, Service and Solution — Vietnam Digital Awards 2025

bullets.tradexpo: TradeXpo — Digital Exhibition Platform: built core pages (home, event list, event detail, inner pages) and the full user journey from landing to event and booth interactions.
bullets.immersive: Integrated a 3D/VR system using Shapespark through iframe and postMessage; developed gamification including check-in, booth interaction, product viewing, and rewards.
bullets.tracking: Integrated CleverTap for user behavior tracking; optimized UX for media-heavy and dynamic pages; aligned implementation with Figma and product flow.
bullets.mobile: Mobile App (React Native): maintained and fixed bugs in the app inside an Expo monorepo, porting shared Shadcn-style components to mobile.
bullets.award: TradeXpo contributed to the platform winning Excellent Digital Technology Solution at Vietnam Digital Awards 2025.
bullets.cms: CMS Platform — News, FAQ, Career: built a shared CMS for multiple content types, with management pages for articles, categories, and structured content.
bullets.rendering: Applied SSR and ISR for SEO, page speed, and search visibility; supported stable data flow across frontend and backend.

bullets.omnichannel: Omnichannel Order and Inventory — Highlands Coffee: order flows integrating Shopee, Grab, in-store POS, and internal systems; operational dashboards, goods receipt and issue, and inventory tracking.
bullets.dataset: Handled large datasets and complex multi-state order workflows; contributed to business configuration screens for real-time retail operations.
bullets.emenu: Digital e-Menu: menu, item details, shopping cart, order history; temporary bill for real-time spending estimates; cart logic optimized for frequent updates.
bullets.internal: Internal management platform: data-heavy tables, multi-filters, search, pagination; reporting for call activities, work logs, and tax workflows; integrations with Omicall, ClickUp, and GDT.
bullets.uiSystem: Internal UI system: reusable components across projects, standardized usage, Storybook documentation, layout fixes, and manual UI testing.

monorepo.description: A Bun + Turborepo workspace with three app Runtimes cloned from Template apps, sharing eight source-only packages. It is the portfolio you are reading.

bullets.runtimes: Three Runtimes: a Vite SPA, Next.js 16 App Router and React Router 8 framework mode, each behind a Template a generator clones.
bullets.gate: One four-command Gate (Biome, TS 7, Vitest 5, build) mirrored 1:1 in GitHub Actions; Playwright E2E and Docker builds discovered by glob.
bullets.publish: Publishes @fe-monorepo/ui (63 shadcn/Base UI primitives) and @fe-monorepo/hook to npm through Changesets + OIDC trusted publishing, with a tarball smoke test before release.

chat-socket.description: A full-stack real-time chat app: React 19 + Rsbuild on the client, Spring Boot on the server, messaging over STOMP on WebSocket.

bullets.auth: JWT access token + refresh-token session (HttpOnly cookie) on Spring Security.
bullets.realtime: Messages, seen-state and online presence over STOMP, backed by Redis.
bullets.history: Cursor-paginated, virtualised message history (react-virtuoso); friends, direct and group conversations with roles.

smart-rental.description: A rental-management portal: KPI dashboard, floor-grid room map, contract lifecycle and batch invoicing with QR payment.

bullets.portal: React 19 + Rsbuild + React Router; TanStack Query/Table, dnd-kit, nuqs for URL state, shadcn/Radix.
bullets.delivery: Storybook for shared components; CI and production deploys to Vercel through GitHub Actions.
bullets.backend: Spring Boot 4 multi-module backend (UUIDv7, Flyway) — user-service live, property-service in progress.

meta.title: @fe-monorepo docs
meta.description: How to install, import and use the @fe-monorepo/ui and @fe-monorepo/hook packages.

home.title: Getting started
home.description: Two packages published from this workspace: 63 Base UI primitives and 5 React hooks. Both are subpath-only, so you import the one file you need.

install.title: Install
install.description: Add the package to your project.
install.note: Both packages are ESM only and ship no CommonJS build.

peers.title: Peer dependencies
peers.description: You install these yourself; they are not dependencies of the package.

css.title: Set up the stylesheet
css.description: Two lines in your Tailwind v4 entry, and one that matters more than it looks.
css.sourceWarning: Tailwind v4 does not scan node_modules. Without the @source line every class inside the package compiles to nothing, with no error, and the components render unstyled.
css.fragmentNote: globals.css is a fragment rather than a full Tailwind entry: it deliberately carries no @import “tailwindcss”, which is yours to own since tailwindcss is a peer dependency.

example.title: Your first component
example.description: Every primitive lives at its own subpath, named after its file.

noRootEntry.title: There is no root entry
noRootEntry.description: There is no import { Button } from “@fe-monorepo/ui”. The root entry does not exist, so always name the subpath.

components.title: Components
components.description: Every row is a subpath of @fe-monorepo/ui. Open one to read its exports and to see its Storybook demo.

detail.demoDescription: The interactive demo and the live props table live in Storybook.

hooks.title: Hooks
hooks.description: Five shared hooks, one subpath each on @fe-monorepo/hook.

use-debounce.description: Returns value again delay ms after it last changed.

use-media-query.description: Subscribes to a CSS media query; SSR-safe through defaultValue and initializeWithValue.

use-is-mobile.description: useMediaQuery pinned to the Tailwind md breakpoint (768px).

use-copy-to-clipboard.description: Returns [copiedText, copy]; copy resolves false when the Clipboard API is unavailable.

use-isomorphic-layout-effect.description: useLayoutEffect in the browser, useEffect on the server.

meta.title: React Router Template — Monorepo ({appEnv})
meta.description: Template app for the React Router 8 framework-mode Runtime: SSR through react-router-serve, on the same Vite toolchain as the SPA Template.

home.title: React Router Template
home.lead: This page is server rendered and sent complete before any JavaScript runs. Clone this app when you need SSR/SEO without leaving the Vite toolchain — the same bundler, the same React Compiler and the same src/ tree as the SPA Template.

module.lead: One public URL per module: this page is server rendered from the catalogue, so a crawler reads its name and description before any JavaScript runs.

meta.title: About — Monorepo
meta.description: A static page prerendered at build time and served from disk, with no server render.

about.title: About
about.lead: The Template app for the React Router 8 framework-mode Runtime. This page differs from every other one in a single way: it is rendered once at build time, written to build/client, and react-router-serve answers with that file from disk without running any loader.
about.body: Because it is rendered at build time, this page carries the build's default language rather than negotiating from each request's cookie or Accept-Language. Once hydrated, the language switcher works as it does everywhere else.

templates.title: Template list
templates.lead: This section loads after paint through TanStack Query — so it is not in the HTML the server sends, and refreshing it re-runs no loader.
